stages.name: Rig Canonicalization and PBR
stages.gate: armature + weighted mesh + canonical humanoid bones + 1.80-1.90m + valid scale + real assigned PBR material + SHA256 for exported FBX

stages.name: Unreal Candidate Import
stages.gate: candidate import succeeds + SkeletalMesh + Skeleton + >=1 assigned material + source SHA256 matches P0-02 export; baseline skeleton/PhysicsAsset/LOD are diagnostics for P0-04A
stages.replacement_policy: candidate-only; do not replace working HeroV3

stages.name: Unreal Technical QA
stages.gate: same working Skeleton + PhysicsAsset + >=3 LODs + >=2 compatible animations + >=1 assigned material + candidate source SHA256 metadata matches P0-03

stages.name: Hash-Bound D3D12 Visual + Runtime QA
stages.gate: P0-04A PASS + candidate source SHA256 chain + D3D12 side-by-side render + fresh screenshot hash/bytes + combat regression + zero fatal findings
stages.hash_binding: candidate_source_sha256 is mandatory and validated separately across P0-04A/scene/render/runtime/approval

stages.name: Hash-Bound Atomic Promotion + Rollback + Packaged Regression
stages.gate: approved screenshot hash/bytes + candidate source SHA256 + exact git SHA/workflow run ID + provenance + skeleton match + transactional promotion + full cook/stage/pak/archive + packaged combat regression
stages.rollback: transactional; ACTIVE must never be left empty

blockers: AsusRog is currently Offline in Remote Desktop Commander
local_execution.concurrency_policy: latest canonical run only; older queued runs cancelled automatically
local_execution.note: When the Windows self-hosted runner returns online, GitHub can execute P0-01 through P0-04B. P0-05 remains blocked by hash-bound visual approval.

repository_verification.note: Repository/static contracts are green. This does not substitute for P0-03/P0-04A/P0-04B local Unreal execution.

structural_guards: OpenGL normal converted to DirectX normal
external_candidate_execution.warning: Embedded idle has only one chest-rotation channel; production locomotion/combat must come from HeroV3 animation library after Unreal compatibility/retarget validation.

adoption.policy: P0-01/P0-02/P0-03/P0-04A are the canonical hero production gates. Working HeroV3 remains authoritative runtime hero until P0-04B passes.
adoption.fallback_policy: 2.5D billboard relief is emergency reference output only and can never replace the runtime skeletal hero.
adoption.promotion_rule: No replacement of SK_NARIS_AshenVessel_v3 until P0-04B D3D12 visual/deformation/weapon/combat regression is PASS.
